verdict: corpus/90-verdicts/wave1/W1-30-SHADOW-CASTERS-r1.json (+ .md) — 7/10, minimum over six named axes, clears the wave-1 gate of 7.0. Filed PROVISIONAL rather than PASS for two reasons about the critic and not the piece: CRITIC-DOCTRINE §8 requires raw measurements before the builder's summary is read and the brief directed the opposite order, and ran_every_assigned_method is false (no orbit, no human read).
summary: Nothing landed by this round is recommended for reversal. R1 confirmed by a rendered A/B that could have overturned it (95% fog at 912/1414/1726 m under sky.js against 48/23/294 m under aerial.js, identical sigma0/H/camera Y). The canopy budget re-taken independently: the hardware run contains six SAME-CONFIGURATION repeats measuring its own spread at up to 1.59 ms against a canopy delta of at most 0.60 ms, so the ruling holds and the 'not monotone in triangle count' strangeness is the instrument, not the GPU. The builder's largest declared gap is closed on hardware: canopy shadows do not shimmer in motion, and the instrument proves it can see shimmer. The Deep Marshes bands are not shadows at all and belong to render/water.js.
headline_findings: R1 — CONFIRMED BY AN ARM THAT COULD HAVE FAILED. tools/visual/w1-30-fog-owner-ab.mjs renders the same three Deck vistas at HEAD and on a control clone with installAerialPerspective() uncommented. sigma0, H and camera Y are byte-identical between arms; only the fog law differs. 95% opacity at 912/1414/1726 m (sky.js) against 48/23/294 m (aerial.js). Both arms read the chunk owner out of the live page. Pictures: the Deep Marshes vista is a legible flooded forest at HEAD and a flat grey wash under the model that was winning.

SOME OF THE 13/13 CREDIT BELONGS TO THE WRONG BUILD, AND THE INSTRUMENT CANNOT TELL. Run frame-stats.mjs — the exact screen behind W1-30F's '9 of 13 unusable -> 5 of 13' — over both arms: at vista-deep-marshes it agrees emphatically with R1 (edge 15.22 vs 2.74), and at vista-salt-hills it PREFERS the broken model (edge 3.05 vs 2.79, span 160 vs 128). A statistic that prefers a model painting the marsh opaque at 23 m cannot arbitrate atmospheres. That is the one gap: re-take the thirteen-region pair at HEAD.

THE BUDGET'S SIX ARMS ARE FOUR. w1-30-shadow-casters.mjs#applyArm() only turns flags ON, so once the terrain and geology flags landed in source, base == terrain and terrain+canopy == terrain+canopy+geology — identical casterTriangles AND identical flagged.cast at all three sites. Those six same-configuration repeats spread 0.03/0.13/0.36/0.55/1.23/1.59 ms (median 0.55). Canopy delta against the pair means: -0.37 (blackwood), +0.41 (salt-hills), +0.60 (spawn). Everything-on: -0.10/+0.32/+0.21. THE RULING HOLDS, better evidenced than the builder knew, and the non-monotonicity is fully explained.

MOTION EVIDENCE TAKEN, ON HARDWARE, AND IT IS FAVOURABLE. RTX A5000, three 90-frame walks on one scripted path at eye-blackwood. Statistic is the zero-crossing rate of each pixel's luminance (a smooth ramp scores zero; a texel flip scores one per reversal), because a frame diff scores foliage, camera and defect the same. canopy-off 1.848, canopy-on 1.888 (+2.2%), canopy+under+rock 2.017 (+6.8%). The positive control passes, so the instrument is not blind. R5's caution is corroborated. Plus a 180-frame boundary-walk contact sheet — the first forest walk with the canopy casting.

THE BANDS ARE THE WATER. Offline: the pattern is 0.844 self-similar t0800->t1300 and 0.666 against t1930, negative control 0.046. In-page: shadows entirely off leaves it at rho 0.990 against a 0.957 restore-control floor; hiding the 94 water meshes collapses it to 0.335 and removes 42% of its energy. Owner: game/src/render/water.js, whose own header records the 'axis-aligned 20 m light/dark lanes' its crossed-wave field was meant to remove. Present at eye-blackwood too, not just the Deep Marshes.

THE SHADER-HOOK PATTERN HAS A BIGGER, OLDER INSTANCE. Module-scope ShaderChunk patchers: exactly two, both known, one now dead (confirmed at runtime — uAerial_declared false, so ShaderLib was never touched either). But Material.copy() in three r180 does not copy onBeforeCompile and deep-copies userData, so every .clone() of a worldMaterial drops installSurfaceShader's pass while keeping userData.surfaceUniforms: 305 of 406 materials, including the player's body. Mechanism arm run in the page. NOT this round's file.
corrections_to_the_report: F2's headline row crosses two sites: at Salt Hills `everything` is 1,097,770 triangles, not 1,829,748 (that is Blackwood's, whose medians are 6.09 -> 6.01).
F3's 'terrain alone 0.009%' is an arm with flagged.cast = 0 — it turned on nothing, because the flags were already in the source.

The plan says every child needs a motion gate and an orbit gate; the motion gate is now met on hardware, the orbit gate is not, and no Deck orbit stop answers a question about a caster flag or a fog law. MY OWN SHIMMER ARMS WERE EACH WALKED ONCE. No repeatability estimate for the flicker statistic — the same criticism this verdict makes of the builder's budget. The ordering A < B < C is robust; the size of the 6.8% gap is not claimed.

notes_for_others: W1-30F / whoever quotes the atmosphere: the '13 of 13 regions improved, 9 of 13 unusable frames -> 5' pair was rendered through aerial.js's chunks while they were deleting sky.js's. Do not quote it against the current tree until it is re-taken. Remedy is one capture run: thirteen vistas at HEAD with sky.js's heightFog on and off (heightFalloff = 0 degenerates the integral to plain Beer-Lambert, so no source edit is needed).

W1-30H / whoever owns game/src/render/water.js: the parallel lanes on the water are yours, they are province-wide, and they are the most conspicuous artefact in several shipped frames. reports/visual-truth/deep-marshes-bands/bands.json and reports/runpod-gpu/runs/critic-canopy-motion/artifacts/shimmer/frames/B-canopy-on-f0048.png. Your file's own header says the crossed incommensurate waves were introduced to remove exactly this.

WHOEVER OWNS render/visual-foundation.js AND render/actor.js: Material.copy() does not copy onBeforeCompile and does deep-copy userData, so 305 of 406 materials in the running scene carry userData.surfaceUniforms with no shader installing them — the detail-normal, wear and wetness pass is gone from three quarters of the world including the player's body, while every census says it is present. tools/visual/w1-30-shader-hook-collision.mjs is the probe and carries the mechanism arm. Chain `prior` on assignment, and re-install after any .clone().

ANYONE USING tools/visual/w1-30-shadow-casters.mjs: applyArm() is additive-only. The moment a flag it measures lands in source, that arm becomes a duplicate of its neighbour and the report reads as six arms when it is four. It needs a subtractive mode before it is used to price anything again.

ANYONE RENTING A GPU FOR A FRAME-TIME BUDGET: sample `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu --format=csv -l 1 &` alongside the capture. The shadow-budget run's nvidia-smi.csv holds only the GPU identity line, so nobody can say whether the box was GPU-bound, and stepFrames(1) wall clock is a Node-to-CDP round trip rather than a frame time.

W1-30V: vista-blackwood is confirmed a non-instrument by an independent third measurement — a nineteen-fold change in the fog wall moves its three frame-stats numbers by 0.1 points. It joins vista-valus-ridge.

ANYONE USING tools/control-clone.mjs with a browser: it cannot clone tools/ (npm's symlinks in tools/node_modules/.bin, correctly refused). Use --paths game and pass --entry <clone>/game/index.html, as tools/map/fog-control.mjs does. Page-relative import specifiers ('./vendor/...') then work in both configurations; absolute '/game/...' ones 404.

docs/art-direction/board.json has 92 set targets including FID-AERIAL-exterior_daylight and FID-SHADOWLIT-exterior_daylight — the two rows this round lands on — and nothing in tools/ reads that file.
